errors.text_span: For the "Full model (Ours)" variant, precision is 65.49%, recall is 65.56%, and F1-score is 65.78%.
errors.evidence: The values reported for the 'Full model (Ours)' variant are incorrect and misattributed. The figure shows Precision is 65.45%, Recall is 65.78%, and F1-score is 65.16%. The description reports incorrect values for all three and assigns the value for Recall (65.78%) to the F1-score.
